lessons.title: Daily routines and the Present Simple
objectives: Describe a regular daily routine.
Use the base verb and the he/she/it form.
lessons.explanationRomanUrdu: Present Simple roz ki aadat, baar baar hone wala kaam ya aam haqeeqat batata hai. I, you, we aur they ke saath verb ki base form aati hai: I work. He, she aur it ke saath aam tor par s ya es lagta hai: she works, he goes. Yeh tense sirf abhi chalne wale kaam ke liye nahin hai. Every day aur every morning jaise alfaaz routine ka waqt wazeh karte hain.
rulesRomanUrdu: I/you/we/they + base verb: We work.
He/she/it + verb-s: She works. Go ki shakal goes hai.
Routine ke liye every day ya every morning laga sakte hain.
I work durust hai; I am work durust nahin.

lessons.title: Present Simple negatives and yes-no questions
objectives: Make routine negatives with do not and does not.
Ask and answer questions with do and does.
lessons.explanationRomanUrdu: Present Simple mein aam action verbs ka negative do not ya does not se banta hai. Do not ki chhoti shakal don't aur does not ki doesn't hai. Does ya doesn't ke baad verb base form mein rehti hai: she doesn't work, na ke doesn't works. Sawal mein do ya does subject se pehle aata hai. Am, is aur are ke sawal is pattern se alag hain: Is she ready?
rulesRomanUrdu: I/you/we/they + do not + base verb.
He/she/it + does not + base verb; verb par s nahin lagta.
Do/Does + subject + base verb? Does Ali work here?
Short answer: Yes, he does. No, he does not.

lessons.title: Asking who, what, where and when
objectives: Choose a question word for the information you need.
Build simple information questions with be or do/does.
lessons.explanationRomanUrdu: Question words mukhtalif maloomat poochte hain. Who shakhs, what cheez ya kaam, where jagah, when waqt, why wajah aur how tareeqa poochta hai. Be ke saath question word ke baad is/are aur subject aata hai: Where is the shop? Aam action verb ke saath do/does chahiye: Where does she work? Sawal ka helper dekh kar main verb base form mein rakhain.
rulesRomanUrdu: Who = kaun; where = kahan; when = kab.
Be pattern: question word + is/are + subject?
Action pattern: question word + do/does + subject + base verb?
Why ka jawab aksar because se wajah batata hai.

lessons.title: Actions happening now: Present Continuous
objectives: Describe an action happening now with am/is/are + -ing.
Form a negative and a question about an action now.
lessons.explanationRomanUrdu: Present Continuous bolne ke waqt chalne wala kaam batata hai. Is mein subject ke mutabiq am, is ya are aur verb ki ing form dono chahiye: I am reading. Sirf I reading ya I am read durust nahin. Negative mein be ke baad not aata hai. Sawal mein am/is/are ko subject se pehle le aayain. Abhi aur routine mein farq ko aglay lesson mein dekhenge.
rulesRomanUrdu: I am, he/she/it is, you/we/they are + verb-ing.
Negative: She is not working now.
Question: Are you listening? Short answer: Yes, I am.
Write → writing mein aakhri e nikalta hai; run → running mein n dohrata hai.

lessons.title: Routines compared with actions now
objectives: Choose Present Simple for a routine and Continuous for now.
Use time expressions to explain the difference.
lessons.explanationRomanUrdu: Present Simple aam routine batata hai jab ke Present Continuous is waqt ka chalne wala kaam batata hai. I work in a shop rozmarrah ka kaam hai. I am working at home today aaj ki aarzi surat-e-haal bata sakta hai. Every day, usually aur on Mondays routine ki nishaniyan hain; right now aur at the moment abhi ki taraf ishara karte hain. Tense sirf aik lafz dekh kar nahin, maani samajh kar chunain.
rulesRomanUrdu: Routine: She walks to work every day.
Now: She is taking the bus right now.
Aik hi jumlay mein aam routine aur aaj ka mukhtalif kaam compare ho sakta hai.
Know aur like jaise state verbs ko aam bunyadi maani mein usually Simple mein rakhain: I know, I like.

lessons.title: Yesterday with was and were
objectives: Describe a past place or state with was and were.
Ask and answer past be questions without did.
lessons.explanationRomanUrdu: Was aur were, am/is/are ki past shaklain hain. In se guzray hue waqt ki jagah ya haalat batate hain: I was at home yesterday. I, he, she aur it ke saath was; you, we aur they ke saath were aata hai. Negative mein not lagta hai. Sawal banane ke liye was ya were subject se pehle aata hai. Be ke is pattern mein did nahin lagta.
rulesRomanUrdu: I/he/she/it was; you/we/they were.
Negative: was not = wasn't; were not = weren't.
Question: Were you busy yesterday? Yes, I was.
Yesterday aur last night guzray waqt ko wazeh karte hain.

lessons.title: Finished actions with regular past verbs
objectives: Describe a finished action using a regular -ed verb.
Use did not and did questions with the base verb.
lessons.explanationRomanUrdu: Past Simple guzray hue waqt mein mukammal kaam batata hai. Regular verbs mein aam tor par ed lagta hai: work se worked. E par khatam verb mein sirf d lagta hai: live se lived. Consonant ke baad y ho to aksar ied banta hai: study se studied. Positive past form subject ke saath nahin badalti. Negative did not aur sawal did ke baad base verb rakhain.
rulesRomanUrdu: Positive: I worked. She worked. They worked.
Work → worked; play → played; live → lived; study → studied.
Negative: I did not visit. Did not visited ghalat hai.
Question: Did you visit Ali? Yes, I did.

lessons.title: Past Simple with went, had and ate
objectives: Recognize common irregular past forms.
Keep the base verb after did and did not.
lessons.explanationRomanUrdu: Kuch aam verbs ka past ed se nahin banta. Go ka went, have ka had, eat ka ate, buy ka bought aur see ka saw hai. Inhein chhote jumlon aur maani ke saath seekhain. Positive mein past form hoti hai, lekin did ya did not aane par base form wapas aati hai: Did you go? I did not go. Did you went ghalat hai.
rulesRomanUrdu: Go → went; have → had; eat → ate; buy → bought; see → saw.
Irregular positive past bhi tamam subjects ke saath aik jaisi rehti hai.
Did + subject + base verb? Did she buy a book?
Did not + base verb: We did not have lunch.

lessons.title: Plans with going to and simple future with will
objectives: Describe an intention with be going to + base verb.
Use will for a simple promise or decision.
lessons.explanationRomanUrdu: Mustaqbil ki baat ke liye is lesson mein do bunyadi patterns hain. Am/is/are going to + base verb pehle se irada ya plan batata hai. Will + base verb saada future, us waqt ka faisla ya wada bata sakta hai. I am going to study aaj se socha hua plan ho sakta hai; I will help you madad ka wada ho sakta hai. Tomorrow aur next week future ka waqt wazeh karte hain.
rulesRomanUrdu: I am / she is / they are going to + base verb.
Going-to question: Are you going to travel tomorrow?
Will har subject ke saath aik jaisa hai: I will help. She will help.
Negative: am not going to; will not = won't. Will ke baad to nahin lagta.

lessons.explanationRomanUrdu: Waqt ki aam expressions mein at clock time ke saath, on din ya tareekh ke saath, aur in mahinay, saal ya din ke kuch hison ke saath aata hai. Every day, tomorrow aur yesterday ke bilkul pehle aam tor par in/on/at nahin lagta.
rulesRomanUrdu: At + clock time: at nine; at 3:30.
On + day/date: on Monday; on 5 May.
In + month/year: in May; in 2026. In the morning/afternoon/evening.
At night, lekin tomorrow aur every day se pehle koi preposition nahin: I work tomorrow.

lessons.explanationRomanUrdu: Adjective shakhs ya cheez ki sifat batata hai: a careful driver. Be ke baad bhi adjective aata hai: the driver is careful. Adverb kaam ke tareeqay ko bata sakta hai: she drives carefully. Bohat se manner adverbs adjective mein ly lagane se bante hain, lekin har lafz aisa nahin. Good adjective aur well uska aam adverb hai. Fast adjective aur adverb dono ho sakta hai.
rulesRomanUrdu: Adjective noun se pehle: a slow bus; be ke baad: the bus is slow.
Manner adverb action ko batata hai: He speaks slowly.
Careful → carefully; slow → slowly; clear → clearly.
Good → well; fast → fast. Har adverb ko ly se na banayain.

lessons.title: How often: always, usually and sometimes
objectives: Describe how often a routine happens.
Place frequency adverbs with ordinary verbs and be.
lessons.explanationRomanUrdu: Always, usually, often, sometimes aur never kaam ki frequency batate hain. Aam action verb se pehle yeh adverb aata hai: I usually walk. Be ke baad aata hai: she is always busy. Sometimes jumlay ke shuru mein bhi aa sakta hai. Never ka maani pehle se negative hai; bunyadi standard English mein I never drive kaafi hai, I do not never drive nahin.
rulesRomanUrdu: Always = hamesha; usually = aam tor par; often = aksar.
Sometimes = kabhi kabhi; never = kabhi nahin.
Ordinary verb se pehle: I usually walk. Be ke baad: She is often busy.
How often...? frequency poochta hai; every day aur twice a week bhi jawab ho sakte hain.

Go straight; turn left; turn right. Imperative mein base verb hota hai.
Opposite the bank = bank ke samnay doosri taraf; next to = bilkul paas.

lessons.title: A short everyday conversation
objectives: Link a routine, a past event and a future plan in a conversation.

lessons.explanationRomanUrdu: Chhoti conversation mein pehle greeting, phir aik sawal aur uska jawab, aur phir munasib follow-up kaam aata hai. Sawal ka waqt samajhain: do you aam routine, did you guzra hua kaam aur are you going to future plan pooch sakta hai. Jawab mein sirf yes/no ke bajaye aik chhoti detail bhi dein. rulesRomanUrdu: Routine: What do you do after work? I study English.

reading.text: Mina and Ali meet after work. Mina asks what Ali usually does in the evening. He says he studies English. Yesterday he visited his family. Mina asks about his next visit. Ali is going to visit them on Saturday. Mina says, Have a good weekend!
reading.meaningRomanUrdu: Mina aur Ali kaam ke baad milte hain. Mina poochti hai ke Ali aam tor par shaam ko kya karta hai. Woh kehta hai English parhta hoon. Kal woh apne ghar walon se mila tha. Mina aglay visit ke baare mein poochti hai. Ali Saturday ko unse milne ka irada rakhta hai. Mina achay weekend ki dua deti hai.
